name: ig-islamic-dilemma-study
caption:
New: a free 16-session reading club for The Islamic Dilemma by Christopher W. Frost (@SCApologia).

The argument, in short. The Qur'an speaks warmly of the Torah and the Gospel — calling them revelation from God, "guidance and light," and telling Jews and Christians to follow them. Yet it also contradicts them on central points, from the crucifixion of Jesus to the fatherhood of God. Frost works through the Qur'an itself, not from Christian premises, to lay that tension out and ask what it means.

Chris has read this study and approved it — and we want to be clear about what is whose: the summaries, questions and judgements in it are ours, not his, and nothing in it reproduces his text.

So get his book. It is all the club needs, it is built from the Qur'an rather than from our side of the table, and it footnotes you out to mainstream Islamic-studies scholarship. Then read it with someone — every session has discussion questions, and the optional Apologia Daily deep-dives are clearly marked as ours and entirely skippable.

The aim is not to win an argument. It is to lay the tension out honestly, and to talk it over kindly (1 Peter 3:15).

Free — link in bio.

sub.t: The Islamic Dilemma — published with his approval.
